readings.moment: When the temple bell struck nine, the family took out their watches at dinner
Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine when the watches were checked
When the temple struck ten, in the salon
Madame looked at the salon clock when the temple struck ten; it showed five minutes to ten
Casimir Vauthier went out at twenty-eight minutes past ten by the salon clock
A moment after Casimir came back, the hall clock struck eleven

durations: Between the temple bell striking nine and the temple striking ten: one hour (implied)
whereabouts: Madame Monnier and the others sat down to dinner at the table
Monnier scolded Félix in front of the table
The family went into the salon after dinner
Madame Monnier and Casimir Vauthier played piquet in the salon without a break
Casimir Vauthier went out, saying he must fetch his cigars, at 10:28 by the salon clock
Casimir Vauthier asked Madame to play for him
Madame Monnier sat down at the piano at once and played until Casimir came back
Madame Monnier stopped playing when Casimir came in
Madame Monnier is being interviewed in the dining room
Madame Monnier has been asked to remain in the house until the others have been seen
